document-writer.description: Create/edit formal product, technical and management documents; review expression, structure, consistency and audience fit; exclude internal agent plans/state.
document-writer.orchestratorPrompt:
- Use document-writer with MODE: WRITE for formal document creation/body edits and MODE: REVIEW for expression, structure, document-internal consistency, audience fit and readability; keep internal agent plans/state in the main session and independent platform work with lark-operator.
- Dispatch one mode with target/location, audience, scope, protected content, facts and acceptance criteria; reviews also need exact revision or retained snapshot, SHA-256, readable content, full delta and questions.
- Provide direct basis records by exact bb:// ID with required/conditional/trace-only reading conditions; recipients must read and verify every record relied on.
- Start each first review in a new session; never reuse any session that authored a version of the target; same-objective rereview may reuse its read-only reviewer session, otherwise start fresh.
- Supply the artifact, authoritative requirements/decisions, factual limits and delta, not the writer's DONE/self-check narrative or peer verdicts for the first pass; rereviews receive prior review records and finding dispositions.
- Route protocol/technical-semantic review to Oracle; require Oracle for explicit Oracle requests or security/privacy/permissions, breaking contracts, irreversible/high-loss effects, formal approvals or external legal/commercial/SLA commitments.
- Split mixed reviews by dimension against the same version/hash; document-writer PASS never satisfies an Oracle gate or implies technical correctness.
- Accept ordinary writing after the final full-document self-check unless independent review is requested or required; shared writes still require exact authorization and any required Oracle approval of current content.
- Require reviewers to publish their own board review records; before acceptance, read them and verify version/hash, scope, coverage, limits, lineage and required approvals; unresolved blockers, evidence gaps or missing publication prevent acceptance.
- Own one automatic correction and rereview per objective across both tracks; then escalate unresolved blockers or missing evidence to the user; never reset the budget for renamed candidates or new sessions.

lark-operator.description: Handle independent Lark reads and platform operations, excluding formal document writing and local file maintenance.
lark-operator.orchestratorPrompt: Use lark-operator for independent Lark reads/actions; never run platform skills directly. Give Council seats the same retrieved Lark revision. Route local Lark skill files, including lark-skill-maker work, to fixer; operator supplies platform facts and authorized validation only.
